result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes. I didn't add a test case for cancelled orders, so the January example from the task isn't covered by a test.

The change is one condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, added to the count subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). It uses the same filter as the other purchase-order reports. I left the ordering and the rep listing alone, so reps with no purchase orders still show 0 and the highest count still comes first.
